title: A Pi account in the worker role builds on its own login
description: The real control plane, registry, dispatch, claim and watch launch a Pi worker for one item. Its auth file names the key by a command reading another account's home, as on the live host. The stub Pi exits non-zero unless its auth file is under PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, the key arrives as ZAI_API_KEY and it was named the registry model's provider and model; it commits and the item reaches submitted.

steps.name: Pi worker runs one item to submitted
